# Vue.js UI Standards

Use Vue 3 Composition API, `<script setup lang="ts">`, typed props/emits, and existing design-system conventions. Follow Atomic Design with atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, and views.

Follow W3C WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 by default, targeting WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Use semantic landmarks, one clear heading, labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast, accessible icon names, dialog focus management, reduced motion, and status/error announcements. Design mobile first and prevent overflow and layout shifts.

Include loading, empty, error, pending, validation, disabled, unauthorized, and success states where relevant. Keep data access in services/composables and server authorization outside browser code.
